app.title: Car of the Day
app.tagline: Guess the make, model and year in 5 tries
app.loginModalDescription: Keep your streak and stats, appear on the leaderboard and play from any device.
app.loginError: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.
app.loginLinkTakenBody: That Google account already has saved games. Sign in with it and you'll pick up where you left off — progress from this device can't be merged into an account that already exists.
app.loginFailedBody: Couldn't complete sign-in. Please try again.
app.emailNoPassword: No password: we email you a 6-digit code.

app.emailRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
app.codeEmailTakenBody: That email already has an account with saved games. You'll go into it and pick up where you left off, but the account-less progress on this device can't be merged: it stays behind. If that wasn't the email you meant, change it before typing the code.
app.codeRejected: That code doesn't work. It may be mistyped or expired: ask for another and we'll send a new one.
app.codeNetwork: We couldn't check it. Check your connection and try again.
app.codeResendWait: You can ask for another in {seconds}s
app.codeSpamHint: If you don't see it, check spam. It expires in an hour.
app.codeLinkHint: Reading this on a computer? The email also has a button: tap it and you're in without typing anything.
app.dayRolloverBody: Today's challenge is ready. Reload the page to play it.
app.dayRolloverBodyApp: Today's challenge is ready. Tap to open the new edition.
app.promoBody: Tomorrow's car, one tap from your home screen, with its daily reminder and no browser needed.

howto.title: How to play
howto.p1Texto: Five tries to get the make, model and year. You start right up against the car and, with every miss, the camera pulls back.
howto.p1Alt: A sample photo, pulling back try by try
howto.p2Texto: After each try, make, model and year tell you how you're doing. Always with an icon and a word, never colour alone.
howto.ejCorrectaTexto: Spot on. That field is solved.
howto.ejPaisTexto: Not the make, but the same country.
howto.ejNoTexto: A miss. Try another one next time.
howto.ejAnioTexto: The real year is later. Within ±2 years counts.
howto.p3Texto: A new one arrives every midnight (Spanish time). The sooner you get it, the more points; and win days in a row for a separate streak bonus.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: Your account closes and everything that identifies you is erased. There's no going back.
deleteAccount.goneBody: Your name, your email and Google sign-in if you used it. Your nickname, so you leave the leaderboard, the Hall of Champions and public profiles. And the daily reminders.
deleteAccount.staysBody: The record of your games, now anonymous. Closed months and seasons are ranked from it: if it vanished, other players' podiums would change.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This can't be undone and the account can't be recovered.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Last stop. Confirm and your account is deleted right now, and you're signed out on this device.
deleteAccount.errorRateLimited: Too many tries in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
deleteAccount.errorGeneric: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again in a moment.
